newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 9.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Gulf Arab summit in Doha discusses the setting up of a three-member committee to settle a territorial dispute between Bahrain and Qatar. Bahrain has boycotted the summit.
- Jordan exported goods worth 1.6 million dinars from Palestinian-held areas in 1995 and imported goods worth 10.3 million dinars.
- Tunisia plans to privatise 63 firms worth $1.4 billion by the end of 1997.
- Gulf Arab states to provide financial assistance to boost investments in Morocco.
- Saudi's eastern province chamber of commerce seeks to establish joint ventures with the Philippines.
- Jordanian cement plants seek a $50 million loan from a global financing institution.
